claimText: Holy Cross College is an autonomous women’s arts and science college in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, affiliated to Bharathidasan University. Its aided and self-financed programmes run across two shifts and include humanities, sciences, commerce, social work and selected rehabilitation-related courses.
UGC — Autonomous college, 2020–21 to 2029–30; the list also identifies the affiliating university.
The official college website identifies the institution as a college for women.

This profile concerns Holy Cross College in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, not the similarly named colleges in Nagercoil or Thoothukudi. The programme shift matters when planning daily travel. Students moving to Tiruchirappalli should confirm whether a campus hostel place is available before arranging private accommodation or transport.

The college describes a women’s campus with teaching departments, library services, student associations and health and counselling support. Aided and self-financed courses are arranged by shift, so the exact timetable and access arrangements should be checked against the selected programme rather than a general college schedule.

The programme list includes laboratory sciences, computing, visual communication, social work and rehabilitation-related study. The official eligibility document differentiates subject prerequisites rather than treating all science programmes alike. Professional rehabilitation, audiology and special-education routes require a separate check of the applicable regulator’s current approval; the college prospectus alone is not proof of professional licensing eligibility.

The 2026–27 prospectus identifies Christ the King, Maria Villa, Holy Family and Little Flower hostel blocks and presents accommodation for students from outside Tiruchirappalli. Hostel availability and charges require separate confirmation; an academic admission should not be interpreted as an automatic room allocation.

The prospectus shows a hostel dining facility. No verified current menu, allergy protocol or special-diet commitment was located, so applicants should ask the hostel office about their individual food requirements and mess charges.
The college lists a RAPHA health centre, anti-ragging arrangements and counselling services. These indicate campus support provision without establishing a blanket safety guarantee.

Library, guidance and counselling, health-centre and student-welfare services are listed on the official site. Applicants should use the programme-specific eligibility PDF and the current course list together because some older shift descriptions differ.
